mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos child WHERE child.parent_id = todos.id AND child.deleted_at IS NULL) AS total_subtask_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos child WHERE child.parent_id = todos.id AND child.deleted_at IS NULL AND child.completed = true) AS done_subtask_count, id, parent_id, user_id, title, detail, category, priority, due_date, completed, completed_at, deleted_at, pinned, display_order, created_at, updated_at FROM todos

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (display_order, parent_id, user_id, title, detail, category, priority, due_date, completed) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(display_order), 0) + 1, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{detail}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, COALESCE(#{completed}, false) FROM todos
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET title = #{title}, reminder_notified_date = CASE WHEN (due_date = #{dueDate} OR (due_date IS NULL AND #{dueDate} IS NULL)) AND NOT (completed = true AND COALESCE(#{completed}, completed) = false) THEN reminder_notified_date ELSE NULL END, overdue_notified_date = CASE WHEN (due_date = #{dueDate} OR (due_date IS NULL AND #{dueDate} IS NULL)) AND NOT (completed = true AND COALESCE(#{completed}, completed) = false) THEN overdue_notified_date ELSE NULL END, detail = #{detail}, category = #{category}, priority = #{priority}, due_date = #{dueDate}, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{completed} = false THEN NULL WHEN completed = false AND #{completed} = true THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_at END, completed = COALESCE(#{completed}, completed) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE todos SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, deleted_with_parent = false WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE todos SET deleted_at = NULL, deleted_with_parent = false WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
UPDATE todos SET pinned = NOT pinned WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE todos SET display_order = #{displayOrder}, updated_at = updated_at WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND parent_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
